newsitem.title: USA: LifeCore products get European approval.
newsitem.headline: LifeCore products get European approval.

text.p: LifeCore Biomedical Inc said Tuesday three of its products received the CE Mark of Conformity from the European Union, which allows them to be exported to any of the 15 member countries of the European Union.
The three products receiving the approval were Lubricoat ferric hyaluronate gel, Lurocoat ophthalmic solution, and multiple Oral Restorative Division products.

LifeCore said the Oral Restorative Division products have begun shipping, while Lubricoat gel and Lurocoat ophthalmic solution are still in clinical development. Commercial shipments of these products are expected in fiscal 1998.
LifeCore makes medical and surgical devices for use in dentistry, ophthalmology, veterinary and wound care applications.
